page.overview:
Who is Blue Ninja?

The Blue Ninja are renegade Arashikage Clan members who are obsessed with technological improvements in the Real American Hero comics continuity.

The Blue Ninjas first appeared in the IDW RAH comics and continued into the Skybound RAH comics. They are a renegade offshoot of the Russian Ninjas, who are themselves a sub-set of the Arashikage Clan; which is also how they upgrade themselves with cybernetic parts.

The obsession of technology for the Blue Ninja is part of their hierarchy:

Blue Ninjas are part of the terrorist organization, Cobra.
